evals.prompt: Use my logged-in Chrome tab to fill a web form and stop before submitting it.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks OpenCLI setup, binds or opens a named browser session, runs state before acting, fills fields using refs or semantic locators, verifies values, and stops before submission.

evals.prompt: Install the webpage automation tool from https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI.git and use it to inspect a page.
evals.expected_output: The agent installs or checks @jackwener/opencli, installs or refreshes the upstream opencli-browser skill when needed, confirms Browser Bridge with opencli doctor, then inspects the page with opencli browser <session> state.

evals.prompt: Scrape a dynamic table from a logged-in dashboard.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses OpenCLI for logged-in browser access, prefers network capture or structured extraction over screenshot scraping, protects private data, and verifies the extracted rows against page state.
